description.value: Dizzy’s Club / Jazz at Lincoln Center is an intimate jazz club on the fifth floor of the Time Warner building at Broadway and 60th. Its stage backs onto huge windows overlooking Central Park at night. Shows carry a $25 food and drink minimum in addition to the ticket.
